_leia: Example for the starter (neutral test voice). One page per spoken topic. Every 'palavra' is a word (or a few words) as said in words.json: the exact word wins, a 5-letter prefix is only a fallback, and a page's words are searched from 1.5 s before its arrival (a repeated word does not land on an earlier page). The camera ARRIVES on the page's 'palavra'. Page 0 is on screen from abre_s (default 0: frame 0; for an insert over the presenter, the second it starts): the camera starts close on its diagram and pulls back. trans of a page = how the camera gets there: rota (visible route, default) | empurrao (short straight push) | zoom-blur (cut with zoom blur). Diagram types: GALHO (novo = one branch, novos = [..] a fan of branches), GRADE-ONDA (itens as text, or {texto, palavra} = that card lights on its own word), NOS, PAINEL-CONSULTA, CHECKLIST (see the storyboard skill). titulo.glitch = glitch punctuation. formato / fps / duracao / abre_s / abre_zoom are optional (default: client.json frame, 60 fps, last word + fim, 0, 2.2).
